subject: Urgent: Authorization anomaly — IRP & SOC 2 evidence onboarding
messages:
From: Elena Moretti <elena@prospectco.com>
To: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: it@prospectco.com
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Brief auth failures observed — request for IRP + SOC2/SIG evidence

Hi Rishi,

We saw a burst of 401/403 responses when our service called Redwood's /v1/generate endpoint between 2026-11-26T20:00:00Z and 2026-11-27T02:30:00Z. Impact was limited to ~3% of calls but it touched our payment flow and prompted an escalation internally.

Can you:
- Confirm whether Redwood observed related auth anomalies in that window,
- Share your incident response plan (IRP) and any post-incident artifacts you can provide, and
- Provide SOC 2 Type II report or SIG/CAIQ attestation material we can pass to our security team and external auditor.

We need sanitized telemetry extracts (timestamps, request ids, status codes) and a short postmortem listing root cause and remediation steps. PII must be redacted.

I can share a minimal evidence template from our auditor if that helps — attaching initial packet. We need an ETA on when we can expect package delivery (preferably within the workday).

Thanks,
Elena Moretti
Head of Platform Security, ProspectCo
Elena.Moretti@prospectco.com

Attachment: prospectco_initial_packet.pdf (reference)

From: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Elena Moretti <elena@prospectco.com>
Cc: neha.kapoor@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 09:35:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Brief auth failures observed — request for IRP + SOC2/SIG evidence

Elena — thanks for flagging and for the packet. We saw correlated auth errors in the same window and I’m pulling the right folks together.

Plan:
- We will assemble an evidence bundle that includes: our IRP summary (execution steps taken), a sanitized telemetry extract (request_id, timestamp, endpoint, response_code), an auth log snippet, and SOC 2 artifacts/SIG crosswalk.
- ETA: initial package in ~6 hours (EOD PST). If you need stricter redaction controls we can provide a redacted CSV plus a viewer-only Drive folder.

Please confirm the exact time range you want included (your note lists two overlapping windows) — I propose 2026-11-26T20:00:00Z -> 2026-11-27T08:00:00Z to be safe. Also let us know whether your auditor requires a signed attestation PDF or if a Drive link plus exported PDFs is acceptable.

I’ve looped in Neha (compliance) and Marissa (IR operations) to own the assembly and secure transfer.

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Customer Security Operations, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com

Cc: neha.kapoor@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com, jonas.weber@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 15:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Brief auth failures observed — evidence package (initial)

Elena — sharing an initial package for review. This contains the items we discussed; sensitive fields have been redacted. If you need a different redaction level let us know and we’ll regenerate.

Package contents (attached / Drive):
- redwood_irp_v2.pdf — condensed incident response timeline and checklist (internal IRP excerpts; redacted operational details)
- telemetry_extract_20261127.csv — sanitized rows: request_id, utc_timestamp, endpoint, response_code, brief_reason_code
- auth_log_snippet.txt — selected auth events around spike with token hash redacted
- sig_caik_crosswalk.pdf — SIG/CAIQ mapping (summary)

Drive (viewer-only, expiring link): https://drive.redwood.com/secure/PC-0459/irp-package
HubSpot record: https://hubspot.company/PC-0459 (internal reference)

Notes / quick summary:
- Observed behaviour: transient token refresh race condition layered with a brief outage in our token issuer (third party). This caused ~3.1% elevated 401s for authorization checks.
- Containment: automatic retry gating and short-circuit fallback launched within 11 minutes of detection.
- Remediation: patch deployed to token refresh handler (race fix) + tightened retry backoff. Expected new behavior eliminates observed window; monitoring alert thresholds adjusted.

Attachments (stubs): redwood_irp_v2.pdf (PDF, 348KB), telemetry_extract_20261127.csv (CSV, 52KB), auth_log_snippet.txt (TXT, 12KB), sig_caik_crosswalk.pdf (PDF, 96KB)

If this addresses your auditor’s initial requests we can produce a formal SOC2 artifact package (signed cover letter + report excerpt) for SecureCorp to consume. Want to schedule a 2pm PST call to walk through?

Thanks,
Rishi

From: neha.kapoor@redwood.com <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Elena Moretti <elena@prospectco.com>, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, jonas.weber@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 17:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Brief auth failures observed — evidence package + short postmortem

Elena — following up with a short postmortem summary and next steps for compliance review. Thanks for the call earlier.

Postmortem (summary):
- Impact window: 2026-11-26T20:07:00Z -> 2026-11-27T01:52:00Z
- Root cause: token refresh race condition triggered by an upstream token issuer instability; retries with concurrent refresh created a small window where valid tokens were not being used for in-flight requests.
- Actions taken: automatic mitigation (retry gating) deployed at 20:18Z; patch to token refresh handler deployed at 21:05Z; monitoring thresholds and runbook updated at 22:00Z.
- Customer impact: transient 401/403 for ~3% of calls; limited to non-returning requests — no stored PII exposure identified.

Compliance artifacts provided: redwood_irp_v2.pdf (IRP summary), telemetry_extract_20261127.csv (sanitized), auth_log_snippet.txt (redacted), sig_caik_crosswalk.pdf (SIG mapping). We will produce a SOC 2 connector package if SecureCorp requires the report excerpt and signed attestation — ETA for that full package is 3 business days.

Next steps:
- Action owner: Marissa Cole will run a final redaction pass and deliver a sealed package for auditors (Marissa assigned).
- If SecureCorp needs a letter of attestation, please direct auditor to secure-audits@redwood.com and we will coordinate.
- Offer: 30-minute technical Q&A with our infra team (Jonas Weber) if your auditor wants live walkthrough of logs/controls.

Regards,
Neha Kapoor
Head of Compliance, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com
